parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel. It is a cylindrical lever used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: The switch allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot point to control the internal valve mechanism.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the frame or base of the faucet, made of stainless steel. It supports the switch and connects to the water supply system.
parts.Functional_description: The frame provides structural stability and houses the internal water channels that direct flow to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the mounting and support structure for the faucet assembly.
